newsitem.title: HONG KONG: FT Holdings debuts at HK$1.02 per share.
newsitem.headline: FT Holdings debuts at HK$1.02 per share.

text.p: Shares of artificial Christmas tree manufacturer FT Holdings International Ltd made their trading debut at HK$1.02 each, compared with their issue price of HK$1.00.
FT Holdings offered 57.5 million shares at HK$1.00 per share. The initial public offering was about 7.48 times subscribed.
The company designs, manufactures and sells artificial plants, specialising in Christmas trees.

FT Holdings said it would use the proceeds to set up a floral products manufacturing joint venture in northern China and expand production facilities at its plant in Dongguan in Guangdong province, as well as for working capital.
